summary: Added baseline ignore rules and corrected TestClient fixture lifecycle handling; full suite passes.
root_cause: The pytest fixture returned TestClient without entering its context manager, so Starlette did not run FastAPI lifespan startup.
prevention: Use TestClient as a context manager whenever API tests depend on application lifespan state.

summary: Human-approved deletion, local Git initialization, explicit 32-file baseline staging, root commit, and post-commit verification completed without remote or Kimi-zone changes.
Recorded an end-of-day repository and gate status with accepted, draft, pending-commit, and not-started work kept distinct.
Accepted and locally committed an isolated voice transcription preview with bounded input, safe temporary-file cleanup, cancellation handling, and sanitized provider errors.

Reviewed the documentation copy against the canonical repository and identified strong product foundations alongside blocking source-of-truth, contract, external-write, persistence, release, and operations gaps.

Refined the roadmap so Codex owns project context, architecture, integration, and final verification while fresh Kimi Chat sessions receive small context-free leaf tasks with explicit file and test boundaries.
Consolidated the project documentation into one canonical repository and removed obsolete working copies after verified local backups.
Integrated Telegram normalization and bytes-only voice preview after removing a cancellable stream API that could retain unbounded input resources.
root_cause: A public streaming boundary could keep consuming input after cancellation while cleanup waited for provider completion.
prevention: Keep the preview boundary bytes-only with hard limits and wait for bounded provider drain before cleanup.

summary: Accepted a local fake text vertical only after binding verifier inputs to the actual worker result and containing contract-construction failures at the service boundary.
root_cause: The first draft let contract validation escape and gave verifiers only a summary instead of the exact immutable result candidate.
prevention: Build contracts inside the safe boundary and pass one frozen result-bound candidate to every independent verifier.

summary: Accepted trusted ingress envelopes only after removing alternate minting paths, binding exact payload content, completing fallible validation before claims, and requiring envelope-bound task registration.
root_cause: Earlier drafts treated private helpers, syntactic digests and post-claim validation as stronger trust guarantees than they were.
prevention: Mint only inside the raw ingress operation, validate payload-envelope equality and all fallible models before consuming replay claims, then register contract and envelope atomically.

summary: Accepted an isolated stdlib SQLite checkpoint store after independent restart, tamper, tenant, Core-transition, evidence-history and rework/reseal verification.
root_cause: Initial drafts serialized unsafe runtime fields, separated ingress and task commits, and implemented incomplete state and audit invariants that diverged from Core.
prevention: Persist a strict recoverable projection, bind envelope-contract-task in one transaction, reuse Core transition policy, and test real StateManager flows including rework, L4 and terminal states.

summary: Rejected a draft SQLite outbox after isolated reproduction found Gate 4C regressions, broken enqueue/idempotency, stale lease acknowledgement, unbounded crash retries, raw-content persistence and lifecycle tamper gaps.
root_cause: The implementation coupled idempotency behind Task CAS, omitted lease generation and mutable-state integrity, and treated arbitrary strings as safe template data while its test fixture masked most execution paths.
prevention: Separate task-transition and existing-snapshot enqueue semantics, check idempotency before mutation, bind receipts to unique unexpired leases, enforce retry limits, digest lifecycle state and reject raw content before persistence.
